packet_size_bytes.note: after is a single-record file incl. envelope; measured with synthetic 10929-row series

runtime_budget.cadence: 3 personas x 1 daily cycle (weekday cron 0 10 * * 1-5) plus retries; each run writes a claim record and a final record, deduped to one by packet_id
runtime_budget.count_and_growth_per_day: 3 packets/day (more only on retry), about 993 B each => about 2979 B/day
runtime_budget.cap: retention 30 days (PANTHEON_OODA_PACKET_RETENTION_DAYS) and 1000 records (PANTHEON_OODA_PACKET_MAX_RECORDS); list bound 64
runtime_budget.cleanup: pruned at write time and at first start (compact_ooda_packet_store); per-job watermark in ooda_packets.json.index prevents re-consumption

memory.per_pass_replay_check: reads sidecar index only (identities + watermarks), no packet bodies

readers_checked.persona_cycle_controller: reads observe_bundle fields human_feedback/pool/observations/books/harness_observation; none is dropped
readers_checked.harness_adoption/harness_cycle/harness_s: harness_observation, books, observe fields: unaffected (tests pass)
readers_checked.BFF cycle_views/persona_pool: use pool and pool_health, not telemetry
readers_checked.quarter_equity_observations: read from owner (telemetry runtime-summaries) by BFF personas/service.py, never from packets; packets keep length, sha256 and source_ref

rollback: compacted file is still a JSON array of packet_snapshot envelopes; test_legacy_file_compaction_keeps_identities_and_old_reader_parses parses it with the previous reader logic; the sidecar .index is ignored by the old release and rebuilt if it writes the file
manifest: /data/bff/ooda_packets.json: owner persona, bound_status bounded (the checker accepts bounded/unbounded/unreviewed only; bounded is the reviewed-with-proof state)
review_independence: Codex out until 2026-11-20; Antigravity until 2026-11-18T01:34Z; if no other family has capacity at review time, record the exception
